**Finding submitted — deviation (NOSOLICIT).**

- **Responsive locations:** § 12.4 (p0051) is the only non-solicitation covenant in the agreement (searches for "solicit" and "employ/engage/hire" returned no other hits); § 12.3 (p0050) is the related Customer-freedom clause.
- **Why it fails fallback:** one-way against Customer only; eighteen months (and measured from termination, not from the end of a person's involvement); covers *any* person employed by Vendor at any time during the term rather than personnel directly involved in the Services; bars "engage," which operates as a no-hire; no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. It also directly contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no no-hire commitment.
- **Target chosen:** preferred, because narrowing this single sentence to the fallback would require rewriting essentially all of it. One surgical replace substitutes the covenant with an express statement that Customer is subject to no non-solicitation restriction, leaving the § 12.4 numbering and all other text intact and resolving the § 12.3 conflict. The mutual 12-month fallback is offered in the comment.
